Nothing is extended; a few names show insider buying but thin channel stacks, so the desk's read is concentrated in a handful of tech names with multi-channel alignment, not a market-wide signal.
regime_read_zh: 当前图景是超大型科技/国防关联股的广泛共振：披露的政治持仓（佩洛西、麦考尔、MTG）遍及 MSFT、NVDA、GOOGL、AMZN、AAPL、META，同时 AT&T 及参议院多项国防/拨款法案体现国防与财政合同渠道的独立信号。没有任何标的超买；少数个股出现内部人买入但渠道栈较薄，因此桌面对冲集中在少数多通道共振的科技股，而非市场级信号。

ORCL — cloud infrastructure demand alongside Azure expansion
AI power/infra buildout — datacenter power demand is a direct MSFT capex read-through

second_order: VZ — same federal telecom/defense infrastructure spend reads through
CSCO — government networking/security spend alongside AT&T contracts

falsifier.text: AT&T's next quarterly government/enterprise segment revenue declines sequentially, or the continuing resolution fails to extend federal telecom/defense contract authority past December 4, 2026
